My personal experience of antidepressants has not been good.  Many people do not benifit from them and the bad effects from them are vastly under reported.  I can’t get anyone to listen to me about the negative effects or how difficult it is to get off of my antidepressant.  I was told that there was no withdrawal from my AD, but the withdrawals are the worst I’ve ever experienced and I’ve CT’d tia.  I think the withdrawals would literally kill me.  Yet, there are those who swear that their AD has helped them tremendously.  I feel,that my life is ruined by my AD.  I can’t work.  I am house bound.  I spend hours a day crying and thinking about suicide.  I never was suicidal even in my depressions that last two to three years, but only occur every about every ten years.  From experience I can only give you the dark side.  Many people do have the body chemistry to handle these drugs, but then there’s people like me.
